H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse

H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
H481: to tie fast; hence (of the mouth) to be tongue-tied
H1747: stillness; adverbially, silently; abstractly quiet, trust

H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H1197: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating); to be(-come) brutish
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H7093: an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after

H2465: life (as a fleeting portion of time); hence, the world (as transient)

H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H1892: emptiness or vanity; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H5324: to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively)

H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H6960: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H6605: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application

H5061: a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress)
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H8433: chastisement; figuratively (by words) correction, refutation, proof (even in defence)
H3256: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H238: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to

H1616: properly, a guest; by implication, a foreigner
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application

H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H1082: to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction)
H2962: properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
